records.title: Estimated Plastic Weight Density, Annual
records.footnote: Data refer to the estimated weight of plastic debris collected from Singapore's recreational beaches.  The unit of measure is kg of plastic litter collected per km.  The data provided is derived from the total weight of flotsam collected annually from Singapore's recreational beaches, which is subsequently pro-rated based on the estimated plastic weight density established under the Singapore's 2021 Marine Litter and Microplastics Consultancy Study.  According to Singapore's 2021 Marine Litter and Microplastics Consultancy Study, modelling findings showed that a large proportion (around 97%) of plastic litter (including microplastics) found on Singapore's recreational beaches originated from sea-based sources (e.g. ships, transboundary waste) compared to inland contributions.  Additionally, weather factors, particularly monsoon seasons, influenced the transport of plastic debris washing up on our shoreline, and flotsam quantities fluctuate from year to year.  Data are used for SDG 14.1.1 '(a) Index of coastal eutrophication; and (b) plastic debris density'.  Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 14.1.1.
